lines.en: Today has been...eventful if nothing else.
And while I’d like to take this time to pat myself on the back for not violating Molly, the day is not yet over.

There is still plenty of time for me to make a horrible, impulsive decision that will, once again, lead me spiraling downward until the possibility of ever returning to the surface disappears once and for all.
She’s making it easier, though.
Which is strange considering that everything she’s done today has been making something else harder, but...I guess that was kind of the point.
Of course talking wouldn’t have a substantial effect on me when my experience with it is almost entirely impure.
But convincing me that I can do no wrong at this point plays right into my ego.
There was an experiment some twisted scientist did a long time ago where he or she would shock some sort of animal any time it went to take a bite of food.
Whatever that animal was became so scared of that food that it was forced to either starve itself or endure the shock in order to eat.
It starved itself — which is precisely what I’m doing right now.
But the food has grown legs and keeps coming closer- and I am a natural predator who is not known for my ability to stave off temptation.
I can only starve myself for so long before the urge to survive kicks in and I push through the preconceived pain to take what I want.
All I ask is that you keep shocking me every now and then so I do not grow fat and complacent.
And that you stop giving me my favorite treats.
: I never realized just how packed these subway cars can get until I moved here.
: I’d seen rush hour depicted in anime and manga, but had always just assumed that things were being blown out of proportion as it wasn’t ever even close to this where I’m from.
: Do they have subways in Ireland?
: There are commuter trains, but even the ones in busy places like Dublin are above ground.
: Everyone just drove where I’m from. The population wasn’t dense enough to warrant anything like this.
: Things may have been different the closer you got to the city but, being from a small town, things like packed subway cars stay kind of surprising no matter how many times I see or live through it.
: Well, you’re doing a good job of blending in. If it weren’t for your appearance, I probably wouldn’t even realize you’re not from around here.
: Neither of us are doing a good job blending in since we’re the only ones talking right now, Sir.
: We’re supposed to mind our own business and quietly hate ourselves on the subway. That is one of the first things I learned when I moved here.
: Why Kumon-mi anyway? Why not Tokyo or something? That seems to be the hub for most foreigners.
: Yes, which is precisely why I didn’t move there. It would have been too easy, Sir.
: Coming somewhere like Kumon-mi, where outsiders are extremely limited, was a way for me to challenge myself to become better.
: It would have been nice if they made it a little easier for foreigners to find housing, though. Thank Mara for the dorms. Saves me from having to sleep in the sewers.
: And who is Mara exactly?
: The goddess of love in the Imperial Pantheon of the Nine Divines.
: Maybe choose one of the other eight since love hasn’t really seemed to be an area of success for you thus far.
: Thank you for reminding me, Sir. As if you hadn’t already done that an hour-
: Ago?!
: Hey, come on. There’s plenty of room-
: Shh!
: Oh God...I’m in one of those games.
: Molly...sorry, but I-
: Shh!
: What? You too?
: Don’t talk.
: And also, don’t move.
: In fact, don’t do anything.
: This is the part where you stay still and discreet or the game ends. I have experience. Trust me.
: Uhh...
: Just...have to make it to the end of the first level. That’s all. Should be easy.
: Are you-
: Shh. Focusing.
The cage opens and my meal is, once again, placed on an electric panel.
I come to understand her pleas for stillness as I gaze downward and find that our position is one of common concern when train passengers are packed in like sardines.
And while I know Molly to not be the type to cry about me being a groper or anything like that, it is now impossible for me to think of anything other than a forced connection I can not escape from.
Several others press against my back and move me forward- which moves her forward as well. But she has nowhere else to go as she’s already firmly up against the door.

Molly attempts to resist regardless by nudging what little of her body she’s still able to control backward, but that creates an even more immediate problem as it just leads to her grinding against me.
That, paired with the vibration of the train as it moves along its tracks and an echo chamber built to amplify the breathing of those trapped within it-
I am faced with my hardest challenge yet.
And am now just seconds away from allowing myself to be shocked.
: Mm~!
: Shh!
: I’m sorry, Sir...
: You? Why are you-
: That it...has to be me you...wound up like this with...
The harder Molly resists being forced up against the glass, the stronger the connection between us grows.
The tightness of her shorts and the fact that I was circumstantially forced into having an erection make it nearly impossible for me to hold myself back from pressing harder into her.
I can feel my cock being swallowed by the denim-covered flesh of her ass — firmer and tighter than I’ve envisioned it being in the past.
And I can feel it even more when she adjusts and angles herself so I’m caught firmly between her cheeks.
She moves.
So do I.
How apt that the world itself would be the one to force us together when neither one of us has had the willpower or resolve to move forward on our own.
Molly has tried, which is why she’s moving more than I am now.
Which is why she’s pressing back against me with more fervor than before.
Which is why I can feel her body burning up.
Which is why I can see the glass in front of her beginning to turn white with fog.
Which is why I grow harder.
Which is why I feed into the cycle and push back.
Which is why she presses back again with more fervor than before.
Which is why she continues to burn.
Which is why-
: This stop is...Shiori-eki...Shiori-eki.
: Okay! Time for a break!
: Are we-
: Day one ends with your character deciding that you’ve had enough! And with mine questioning her sanity in a public restroom!
: Our stop wasn’t for-
: I know when our stop was! We just came way too close to fulfilling a lifelong fantasy of mine and I need several minutes to myself before we’re both arrested for public indecency!
: Oh god, does everyone masturbate in public restrooms? Am I the weird one for not doing that?
: Probably not! But it does comfort me knowing I’m not the only person you’re aware of who has stooped to this level of degeneracy!
: Also, now’s as good a chance as any if you want to join the club! Because either you were feeling it back there too or you have a very oddly shaped wallet!
: I...was obviously feeling it.
: Would it be presumptuous for me to invite you into the restroom at this point in time, Sir?!
: Presumptuous? No. Dangerous? Yes.
: Danger is the whole point!
: But even then, no one ever comes to this station! If we’re going to have our first actual sexual encounter in a bathroom, this would be the one!
: Considering I’m still on the fence when it comes to doing that with you-
: The fence, my arse! What we did back there would already be sex by Irish Catholic standards! Are you coming or not?!
: Damn it, Jim! I’m a pervert, not a princess! I don’t have all day to wait for you to select a damn option from the dropdown menu!
Don't do sex (Now fully implemented!)
: You...go ahead. I think I need a little more time.
: Understood, Sir! Please do not think less of me for anything that happened today and I will promise to not think any less of you!
: Have...fun, I guess?
: Steady hands, Emerald Guardian...now is not the time to falter!
: You know exactly what you were doing when you packed this! The train was merely a setback!
: Eureka! Viva la Molly!
: Heh?
: Umm...
: Wakana?...
: Yes, my dear?
: There’s...someone there...isn’t there?
: Yes, my dear.
: I thought you said no one ever came to this station?! Why would you lie to me?!
: Neither of us were ever here and we never speak about this again. Understood?
: Understood.
: Come now, Osako. We have overstayed our welcome.
: Wakana! I still have to get dressed!
: Arakawa? What are you doing here?
: I could ask you two the same question. Last I heard, no one ever came to this station.
: It was a lie.
: It’s all a lie.
: Nothing is real.
: What’s her problem?
: She had a bad lunch. Pay it no mind.
: I’m glad I bumped into you, though. I’ve been meaning to ask if your class had any final entries for the poetry contest.
: That hasn’t happened yet?
: The deadline is just before the next batch of standardized tests, which will be here before you know it.
: Those are a thing again too?
: Do you do...any of your job? Or do Imani and Miyamura just earn your paycheck for you at this point?
: They more or less just earn my paycheck for me. But I’ll follow up with them and see if they know anything the next time I’m back in school.
: Understood.
: Have you decided if you’ll be submitting anything? I’ve been looking forward to-
: I don’t know.
: You disregard the sanctity of the dare, Arakawa. Do you mean to say that honor and loyalty mean nothing to you?
: I mean to say that I’m just not that great at putting my feelings into words anymore.
: You had no trouble putting them into a predatory kabedon in the local library, though.
: Please don’t say things like that in front of a woman who could kill me with one kick.
: Write something, Arakawa. We both know you can.
: I’ll...see what I can do.
: Also, did you bump into Molly by any chance?
: AaaaaAAAAaaaAAAAaaaaaAAAaaaaaaAAAaaaaAAAaaahhhhhhhhh.........
: I have never met anyone who goes by that name before.
: Wasn’t she in your-
: I have never met anyone who goes by that name before.
: I think I understand everything now.
: You understand nothing and I was never here. Goodbye, Arakawa.
: Yeah...see you.
Wakana drags Osako away and, after another five minutes or so, Molly returns from the restroom beet-red and sweaty.
Which is, not-so-coincidentally, the same state she walked into the restroom in. But I hope she was able to hold herself over for now.
Not just because it looked like she was going to burst if she had to go another five minutes without an orgasm-
But because I am now just one more dark room and one more push away from giving her as many as her heart desires.
The shock won’t kill me.
And I will be okay.
Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!
